name: COMO Parrot Cay
address: Parrot Cay, Turks and Caicos Islands
tagline: A 1,000-acre private island between Providenciales and North Caicos.
description:
COMO Parrot Cay is a private-island resort on Parrot Cay, in the Turks and Caicos, between Providenciales and North Caicos. The island covers 1,000 acres and is edged by four miles of white sand. There are 74 rooms. British decorator Keith Hobbs designed the interiors, in whitewash, cotton and teak. Providenciales International Airport (PLS) is about 50 minutes away: a 15-minute drive to Leeward Marina, then a 35-minute boat.

Beach houses, villas and residences have private pools and a path onto the sand. Terrace rooms are about 60 square metres. COMO Suites are about 120 square metres, with a living and dining area and a balcony. Beach houses run from one to three bedrooms and come with a butler. Private residences go up to 11 bedrooms. The resort takes families. Play by COMO runs activities for children aged 4 to 12, and babysitting can be arranged.

Lotus, by the pool, serves Caribbean dishes by day and Asian dishes at night. Terrace cooks modern Italian, indoors and outside. The COMO Beach Club, on the main beach, is for snacks and cocktails. Half-board and full-board plans are available. A kosher kitchen, with a private chef, can be arranged in any accommodation that has a full kitchen. COMO Shambhala Kitchen dishes are served in the restaurants and on the in-room menu.

The COMO Shambhala Retreat stands away from the villas, with treatment pavilions toward the North Caicos Channel, a yoga pavilion, a Pilates studio and a Jacuzzi garden. It has nine treatment rooms, a private cottage, a meditation hut, a gym, double massage rooms and Japanese baths. Bicycles are complimentary. Kayaks go into the mangrove channels, where guides point out turtles, herons and egrets. There is a watersports centre, and dive courses run with Big Blue. North Caicos is a short crossing away. In an average year the islands have about 350 days of sunshine.

COMO Parrot Cay suits families and couples who want a long beach, a pool at the door of the villa, and a spa a short boat ride from Providenciales.
